source: Wayne County 2026–2030 parks and recreation plan, individual Wayne County park profiles, Michigan Water Trails; listed positions are park/place reference points, never guaranteed parking entrances.

entries.name: Newburgh Lake Pointe Public Access
entries.note: Distinct lakeside access area across the water from Lake Pointe Yacht Club, described during a field visit. Exact public entrance and parking pin awaiting field confirmation; do not treat Newburgh Pointe’s map pin as this entrance.
entries.provenance: Visitor field report; exact public entrance location needs verification

entries.name: Bennett Arboretum
entries.note: Historic arboretum and wooded trails near Northville. Exact trailhead pin needs verification.

entries.name: Northville Recreation Area
entries.note: Northville-area picnic spaces and trail connection. Park reference point, not turn-by-turn entry coordinates.

entries.name: Cass Benton Park
entries.note: Wooded slopes, disc golf, and historical park facilities. Park-area reference, not an exact parking entrance.

entries.name: Waterford Bend Park
entries.note: Riverside picnic area and distinctive play structure. Entrance pin needs verification.

entries.name: Springbrook Recreation Area
entries.note: Named recreation area in Wayne County’s Hines Park inventory. Location pin needs verification.

entries.name: Wilcox Lake
entries.note: Plymouth-area lake, fishing and shoreline restoration. General lake reference, not a boating access guarantee.

entries.name: Wilcox Park
entries.note: Picnic shelter and public park facilities near Wilcox Lake. Site pin still needs verification.

entries.name: Gunsolly Mills Park
entries.note: Historic carding mill site, park shelter, and RC vehicle track. Entrance pin needs verification.

entries.name: Plymouth Riverside Park
entries.note: Historic comfort station, shelter, and playscape along the Rouge.

entries.name: Haggerty Recreation Area
entries.note: Wayne County First Responders Memorial and athletic areas. Precise park pin needs verification.

entries.name: Newburgh Pointe
entries.note: Wayne County’s Newburgh Lake park node with fishing piers and boat launch. Separate from Newburgh Lake Pointe Public Access.

entries.name: Newburgh Lake Public Boat Launch
entries.note: Documented public boating access west of Newburgh Road. Distinct from the unverified lakeside access described by a field visitor.

entries.name: Sumac Pointe
entries.note: Public lake frontage, kayak launch and fishing dock. Separate from Newburgh Pointe.

entries.name: Levan Knoll Park
entries.note: Hillside with boardwalk and wildflowers. Stay on signed public trails.

entries.name: Oak Grove
entries.note: Nankin Lake recreation area with non-motorized boat access and trails.

entries.name: Nankin Mills Park
entries.note: Historic park and Nankin Mills Interpretive Center area; see the center’s own entrance details.

entries.name: Nankin Mills Interpretive Center
entries.note: Historic mill and interpretive exhibits. Reference pin drawn from DRIFT’s existing catalog; check visitor entry details.

entries.name: Elm Grove Park
entries.note: Park facilities and wetland surroundings.

entries.name: Valley View Park
entries.note: Ball fields in the central Hines corridor. Exact park pin needs verification.

entries.name: Hawthorne Ridge Park
entries.note: Wayne County bike park and pump track, plus dog park. Precise entry pin needs verification.

entries.name: Merriman Hollow Park
entries.note: Shelter, ball field, LightFest corridor access.

entries.name: Maple Grove Recreation Area
entries.note: Named in Wayne County’s recreation inventory. Exact pin needs verification.

entries.name: Sherwood Park
entries.note: Open recreation space alongside the Middle Rouge. Exact entrance pin needs verification.

entries.name: Middlebelt Hill / Dead Man’s Hill
entries.note: Local hill landmark; avoid closed or restricted slopes. Existing DRIFT area reference.

entries.name: Perrin Park
entries.note: Ball fields and recreation spaces. County reports shelter construction restrictions for 2026.

entries.name: Nolar Bend Park
entries.note: Riverside recreation area and ball fields.

entries.name: Wallaceville Park
entries.note: Wetland-edge recreation area and soccer fields.

entries.name: Parr Park
entries.note: East-end Hines recreation area.

entries.name: Boy Scout Shelter
entries.note: Existing DRIFT eastern shelter reference; verify current access before visiting.

entries.name: Warrendale Park
entries.note: Shelters, courts, and ball/soccer fields. Exact park pin needs verification.

entries.name: Helms Haven Park
entries.note: Riverbank shelter and recreation area; DRIFT’s Middle Rouge Relay signal is nearby.

entries.name: Parkland Recreation Area
entries.note: Eastern Hines recreation area.

entries.name: Old Village / York Street Cemetery
entries.note: Historic cemetery reference. Never a cache placement or approach target.

entries.name: Riverside Cemetery
entries.note: Historic cemetery reference. Never a cache placement or approach target.

entries.name: Chief Tonquish Burial Site Marker
entries.note: Memorial reference only; do not place caches or encourage access to burial areas.
